title: SARS-CoV-2 exploits cellular RAD51 to promote viral propagation: implication of RAD51 inhibitor as a potential drug candidate against COVID-19.
authors: Pham, Thuy X; Huynh, Trang T X; Choi, Jiwon; Lee, Jae-Bong; Park, Seok-Chan; Kim, Bumseok; Lim, Yun-Sook; Hwang, Soon B
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SARS-CoV-2利用宿主RAD51促进病毒复制，涉及RAD51抑制剂和分子对接，但核心是病毒-宿主蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Viruses are constantly evolving to promote propagation in the host. Here, we show that severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) utilizes host RAD51 for replication. Silencing of RAD51 impaired SARS-CoV-2 propagation. Viral RNA colocalized with RAD51 in the cytoplasm of SARS-CoV-2-infected cells, suggesting that both viral RNA and RAD51 may form a replication complex. We, therefore, evaluated RAD51 inhibitors as possible therapeutic agents against SARS-CoV-2. Indeed, RAD51 inhibitors exerted antiviral activities against not only Wuhan but also variants of SARS-CoV-2. Molecular docking model shows that RAD51 inhibitors impede SARS-CoV-2 propagation by interfering with dimerization of RAD51. These data suggest that RAD51 may represent a novel host-based drug target for coronavirus disease 2019 treatment.
abstract_zh: 病毒不断进化以促进其在宿主中的传播。在此，我们展示了严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2型（SARS-CoV-2）利用宿主RAD51进行复制。沉默RAD51损害了SARS-CoV-2的传播。在SARS-CoV-2感染的细胞中，病毒RNA与RAD51在细胞质中共定位，提示病毒RNA与RAD51可能形成复制复合体。因此，我们评估了RAD51抑制剂作为针对SARS-CoV-2的潜在治疗药物。确实，RAD51抑制剂不仅对武汉株，而且对SARS-CoV-2的变异株均表现出抗病毒活性。分子对接模型显示，RAD51抑制剂通过干扰RAD51的二聚化来阻碍SARS-CoV-2的传播。这些数据表明，RAD51可能代表一种新的基于宿主的药物靶点，用于2019冠状病毒病的治疗。
